in_sanskrit.name: जुनास
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Junas in Sanskrit is derived from the words 'vikas' meaning development and 'vikasit' meaning made or created. It also carries the meaning of 'ujjval' which translates to brilliant or illuminated. This name signifies growth, progress, and illumination.

in_hindi.name: जुनास
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Junas in Hindi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vikas' meaning development and 'vikasit' meaning made or created. It also carries the meaning of 'ujjval' which translates to brilliant or illuminated. This name signifies growth, progress, and illumination.

in_tamil.name: ஜுனாஸ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Junas in Tamil is derived from the Tamil words 'vigaram' meaning change and 'ullamal' meaning complete or entire. This name signifies the idea of transformation and completeness.

in_telugu.name: జునాశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Junas in Telugu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'prasada' meaning grace and 'prasadit' meaning bestowed or blessed. This name signifies the idea of receiving grace or blessings.
